title: oxconf
description: Configuration file for oxctl (YAML, filename: oxconf, no extension)

image.description: Full container image URI including tag (e.g. 123456789.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/app:abc123)

container-name.description: Name of the container inside the task definition to update with the new image

container-port.description: Port the container listens on (used when creating a new service with a load balancer)

task-def.description: Path to the ECS task definition JSON template file

wait.description: Whether to wait for the ECS service to reach a stable state after deployment

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for the stability wait (used only when wait=true)

desired-count.description: Number of task instances to run (used when creating a new service)

subnet-ids.description: VPC subnet IDs for the Fargate task network configuration (required for service creation)

security-group-ids.description: Security group IDs for the Fargate task network configuration (required for service creation)

target-group-arn.description: ARN of the ALB target group to attach when creating a new service

log-group.description: CloudWatch log group name to ensure before deploying. Defaults to /ecs/<service>
